solutions.title: Sort and scan
solutions.strategy: Sort the values and return the first index whose value does not match it.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The implementations sort the driver-isolated input in place.

solutions.title: Gauss sum
solutions.strategy: Subtract the actual sum from the expected arithmetic-series sum.

solutions.title: XOR
solutions.strategy: XOR all indices and values, then include n to cancel every present value.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every index and value is processed once.
